economy.summary: Authored an amendment to the state's Solar for Schools grant legislation requiring American-made products in school solar projects, saying American workers and American manufacturing should benefit from the program.
economy.short: Authored amendment requiring American-made products in school solar projects.

taxes.summary: Supported the 2025-26 state budget, saying its objectives were met without touching Pennsylvania's Rainy Day Fund and that it tightens administration of nutrition assistance by removing applicants he says are taking advantage of the system.
taxes.short: Supported 2025-26 budget; cites Rainy Day Fund, benefits administration.

abortion.summary: His official House member page says he is committed to defending pro-life values; it does not detail specific abortion legislation.
abortion.short: Official page says committed to defending pro-life values.

education.summary: Says the 2025-26 budget makes meaningful education reforms by doubling the Economically Disadvantaged Schools tax credit, which funds scholarships for students in schools he describes as failing.
education.short: Supports doubling tax-credit scholarships for students in failing schools.

energy.summary: Supported the 2025-26 budget provision pulling Pennsylvania out of the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, saying the program spiked electricity costs and chased jobs to other states, and backed changes to the environmental permitting system to start new projects sooner.
energy.short: Supports RGGI exit; says program spiked costs, chased jobs.

guns.summary: His official House member page says he is committed to supporting law enforcement and fighting for Second Amendment rights; it does not detail specific firearms legislation.
guns.short: Says he supports law enforcement and Second Amendment rights.

economy.summary: Her campaign platform calls for raising Pennsylvania's minimum wage from $7.25 to a living wage, passing paid sick leave and family leave legislation, and lowering utility costs while combating price gouging.
economy.short: Supports raising minimum wage, paid leave, lowering utility costs.

taxes.summary: Her campaign platform supports property tax relief for seniors and working families.
taxes.short: Supports property tax relief for seniors and working families.

abortion.summary: In a 2024 WESA candidate survey she said no woman should have to justify her decision of what to do with her own body, and that she wants to eliminate restrictions and expand access.
abortion.short: Says eliminate abortion restrictions and expand access.

education.summary: Her campaign platform calls for fully funding public schools through equitable formulas, competitive teacher compensation, investing in school nurses and mental health services, holding cyber charter schools accountable, and expanding workforce training programs.
education.short: Proposes fully funding public schools, teacher pay, cyber charter accountability.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform proposes capping insulin and prescription drug costs, protecting and expanding Medicaid access for working families, banning insurance coverage caps, safeguarding pre-existing condition protections, and enhancing rural healthcare and mental health services.
healthcare.short: Proposes capping drug costs, expanding Medicaid, protecting pre-existing conditions.
